title: The Gallery After Dark
description: A priceless painting vanished from a locked gallery during a charity event. The curator insists only a tiny group could have done it.

truth.sequence: Mara duplicated the service key and hid the painting in a delivery crate.

alibi.claim: I was on the mezzanine speaking to donors at the time.

evidence.name: Service Door Log
evidence.description: The service door opened with Mara's staff credential at 22:58.

evidence.name: Crate Weight
evidence.description: A delivery crate signed by Mara weighed 18 kg more than its manifest indicated.

evidence.name: Key Impression
evidence.description: A duplicate key matching the service lock was found in Mara's desk drawer.

opening_statement: I was protecting the collection all evening. Losing the painting is a failure of security, not proof that I stole it.
